_formalism: Goal-Oriented Graph (GoG) - Leung, Wang, Shen, 'From entity-centric to goal-oriented graphs', Knowledge-Based Systems 341 (2026) 115706. Directed graph G=(V,E); each node is a goal with Name/Description/Required Tools/Required Materials/Preconditions/Postconditions (Table 1); edges encode goal->subgoal (prerequisite) relations, each with a description; graph is acyclic so DFS from a root goal yields a well-defined goal tree.

nodes.description: Face a tree and use the Do action to obtain wood.

nodes.description: Place a crafting table on grass, sand or path, consuming wood.
